set.body:
Replace FieldRole and misleading aliases with evidence-backed value and semantic capabilities.

Design requirements
- Separate value structure from legal interpolation/sampling behavior.
- If a phantom semantic parameter remains, construction requires evidence connecting element type A to the semantic capability.
- Linear interpolation is available only with LinearInterpolable[A] or equivalent evidence; nearest sampling remains available for categorical values.
- Scalar images are generic in A where the semantics permit it.
- ImageSeries requires checked evidence for a unique series axis, normally Time.
- Component views require checked component-axis evidence; Components does not imply RGB, displacement, eigenvector, or tensor transformation law.
- Vector and tensor transformation laws remain in reframe4s or domain libraries.
- Downstream libraries can define custom semantics without editing a sealed core enum.

Acceptance criteria
- No public alias claims a time/component/scalar invariant that construction did not verify.
- Ordinary continuous Double images and categorical integral labels remain concise.
- Zero-copy semantic views contain no second data owner.
- Output semantics for mapValues and zipWith are explicit rather than guessed.

Tests
- Negative compile-time tests reject String continuous interpolation, linear label sampling, a time-series view without a unique Time axis, and a component view without valid axis evidence.
- Positive compile-time tests accept downstream custom value semantics without core modification.
- Runtime tests reject missing/ambiguous axes with typed errors.
- Zero-copy tests prove semantic views retain the exact immutable Ravel data owner.
- Reference nearest/linear tests demonstrate capability-directed API availability on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Replace image roles and aliases with proven value semantics
